passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the author.
This is a song or poem.
David directed this psalm to the LORD.

passages.text: The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
The LORD owns the earth.
Everything in the earth belongs to the LORD.
The world belongs to the LORD.
Everyone who lives in the world belongs to the LORD.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לַֽ֭יהוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
passages.sermon: The LORD made the earth.\r\nHe built it on the seas.\r\nHe set it firmly on the waters.
passages.original: כִּי־ ה֭וּא עַל־ יַמִּ֣ים יְסָדָ֑הּ וְעַל־ נְ֝הָר֗וֹת יְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃

passages.text: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
His hill is holy.
His place is holy.
Who can go up the hill of the LORD?
Who can stand in His holy place?
passages.original: מִֽי־ יַעֲלֶ֥ה בְהַר־ יְהוָ֑ה וּמִי־ יָ֝קוּם בִּמְק֥וֹם קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
passages.sermon:
The person may ascend the hill of the LORD and stand in His holy place if he has certain qualities.
He must have clean hands.
He must have a pure heart.
He does not lift up his soul to an idol.
He does not swear deceitfully.
passages.original: נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר־ לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ לֹא־ נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה׃

passages.text: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
passages.sermon: The LORD gives blessing.\r\nThe God who saves gives vindication.\r\nThe person receives both blessing and vindication from God.
passages.original: יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
passages.sermon:
This is the generation that seeks God.
They seek Your face, O God of Jacob.
Selah.
Lift up your heads, O gates.
Be lifted up, O ancient doors.
Then the King of Glory will enter.
passages.original: זֶ֭ה דּ֣וֹר דֹּרְשׁוֹ מְבַקְשֵׁ֨י פָנֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃ שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃

passages.text: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He asks a question.
He says, “Who is this King of Glory?”
The King of Glory is the LORD.
The LORD is strong.
The LORD is mighty.
The LORD is mighty in battle.
passages.original: מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְגִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
passages.sermon:
The King of Glory is the LORD.
The LORD is strong and mighty.
The LORD is mighty in battle.
Gates, lift up your heads.
Ancient doors, be lifted up.
The King of Glory will enter.
passages.original: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים׀ רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וּ֭שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָבֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃

passages.text: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts— He is the King of Glory. Selah
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the subject.
He is the King of Glory.
Who is this King of Glory?
The LORD of Hosts is the King of Glory.
Selah.
passages.original: מִ֤י ה֣וּא זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת ה֤וּא מֶ֖לֶךְ הַכָּב֣וֹד סֶֽלָה׃
